blocks.text:
To: Barbara Hall
Cc: Jeffrey Ochoa, Megan Dudley

We have started the Estes Group experience study, and the first data extract your office sent is loading cleanly. Jeffrey Ochoa has the model shell up, and I am reconciling the member counts against last year's records. Before we go further, there are two points on the data where I need your help.

items: The member file uses a status code we cannot read with confidence. Could you confirm how it distinguishes active members from those who have terminated with a deferred benefit?
The observation window is not stated in the extract. Please confirm the first and last plan years you want the experience drawn from, so we measure against the period you intend.

blocks.text: Once we have those two answers, the census for the {{fact:f:E-2019-001.client}} study is settled on our end, and Megan Dudley can begin the reconciliation in earnest. Neither point is urgent this week.
